question: True or false: a relay swimmer whose take-off pad reads 0.02 seconds before the team-mate's touch is disqualified?
answer: False. The block and wall sensors do not fire at the exact instant of the events they record, so the rules allow a reading of up to 0.03 seconds before the touch. A swimmer shown leaving 0.02 early may still have been on the block when the hand hit the wall.
move: Before judging by an instrument, learn which way it errs.
ask: Before I judge by an instrument, do I know which way it tends to be wrong?
trap: Taking the sensor reading as the exact moment the swimmer left.
